name: @stacksjs/ts-cloud
description: A lightweight, performant infrastructure-as-code library and CLI for deploying both server-based (EC2) and serverless applications.
author: Chris Breuer <chris@stacksjs.com>

scripts.compile:all: bun run compile:linux-x64 && bun run compile:linux-arm64 && bun run compile:windows-x64 && bun run compile:darwin-x64 && bun run compile:darwin-arm64
scripts.zip:all: bun run zip:linux-x64 && bun run zip:linux-arm64 && bun run zip:windows-x64 && bun run zip:darwin-x64 && bun run zip:darwin-arm64
scripts.lint: bun x --bun --package github:pickier/pickier#95de532 pickier run . --mode lint --config ../../pickier.config.ts --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:fix: bun x --bun --package github:pickier/pickier#95de532 pickier run . --mode lint --config ../../pickier.config.ts --fix --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: bun x --bun --package github:pickier/pickier#95de532 pickier run . --mode format --config ../../pickier.config.ts --check
scripts.format:fix: bun x --bun --package github:pickier/pickier#95de532 pickier run . --mode format --config ../../pickier.config.ts --write
scripts.fresh: bun x rimraf node_modules/ bun.lock && bun i

lint-staged.*.{js,ts,json,yaml,yml,md}: bun x --bun --package github:pickier/pickier#95de532 pickier run --mode lint --config ../../pickier.config.ts --fix --max-warnings 0
